title: Challenge-sampling Result check
rationale: Branches test the Result discriminant returned by sample_in_ball_bytes and enter the unwrap/panic path on error. They do not depend on challenge coefficients or secret data.

title: Encoding allocation cleanup
rationale: cbz instructions guard deallocation and unwind cleanup based on allocation length or pointer state.

title: Encoding and decoding Result checks
rationale: Branches test Result discriminants from encode_t0, decode_t0, encode_z, and decode_z. Failure paths lead to unwrap/panic logic.

title: Eta-sampling Result check
rationale: Branch tests the Result discriminant returned by sample_eta_poly and enters the unwrap/panic path on error.

title: Public verification result branch
rationale: The branch reflects verify_internal success or failure. Verification status is an intentionally public API result.

title: Branchless rounding corrections
rationale: LLVM lowers coefficient-dependent corrections to ARM64 csel and fixed-latency smull instructions. No secret-dependent branch or secret-indexed memory access is introduced.

title: Fixed rounding-wrapper loop control
rationale: The branch and indexed load implement iteration over a fixed public audit vector.

title: Sign/verify allocation and unwind cleanup
rationale: cbz instructions guard deallocation, drop, and unwind cleanup.

title: Key generation and signing Result checks
rationale: Branches test Result discriminants from keygen_internal and sign_internal and enter unwrap/panic paths on error.

title: Fixed-offset stack and frame accesses
targets: audit_encoding; audit_multiply_challenge; audit_rounding; audit_sample_ball; audit_sample_eta; audit_sign_verify
rationale: Compiler-generated stack/frame loads and stores use fixed offsets from sp or x29 and are not secret-indexed.
